connection.SW50ZXJjb21SZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source:
A connection to [Intercom](https://www.intercom.com) for contacts, companies, conversations, tags, notes, data events and help center articles.

**Authentication** is the OAuth2 authorization code flow with `oauth2_client_id` and `oauth2_client_secret` from an app created in the Intercom developer hub, or a `token` for an integration that only ever works in its own workspace - Intercom issues one per app for exactly that. Intercom declares no scopes in the flow: what a token may do is set by the permissions granted to the app in its own dashboard, so a capability the integration needs is added there rather than requested here.

**The API revision is sent on every call** as `Intercom-Version: 2.16`, matching the description the actions are generated from. Without it a call would ride whichever revision the workspace's app package happens to name, so the same integration could behave differently in two workspaces.

**Regional hosting**: a workspace lives in the United States (`api.intercom.io`), Europe (`api.eu.intercom.io`) or Australia (`api.au.intercom.io`). Intercom routes a call to the default host on to the right region, so the region normally needs no attention; set the URL to a regional host to address it directly.

Intercom is a trademark of Intercom, Inc.
